top_violation_types.title: Space Requirements - Under 18 Months of Age Separate from Older Children (26 TAC §746.4203)

top_violation_types.title: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio - Additional Employees Required (26 TAC §746.1613(a)(5))

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two caregivers did not know how many children they were responsible for.

top_violation_types.title: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Use and Clean According to Manufacturer's Instructions (26 TAC §746.2411(1))
